title: Rapid assessment of clinical severity for salmonellosis cases via protein family domain analysis and machine learning.
summary: A defined pathogen-genomic result (severity-associated protein-family domains) is produced by ML on clinical Salmonella isolate data, beyond algorithm-only benchmark; candidate status and lack of biological/clinical external validation must be explicit.
ai_technology: Original article Methods/Results analyze clinical Salmonella genome and severity data using Pfam-domain representation and ML; reports 70 candidate domains associated with severe cases.
